paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Abba of Hagronya. His mother married R' Abba and assigned her property in writing to her son. He came before R' Yirmeyah bar Abba, and so forth. R' Abba spoke before Rav Hoshaya, and Rav Hoshaya spoke to Rav Yehudah: Ha-Hovel, 88, end of side a. There is some scribal error in Yuhasin. In Bava Kamma 7b: of Akronya; he asked R' Abba.
